name: Ribwarden
title: Keeper of the Lesser Ossuary
biography: An armored ossuary crawler keeps a crown of old bones balanced over its segmented ribs. Its heavy bladed arms echo Morvane’s long silhouette.
weakness: The skull binding is exposed when the blade arms recover.

skills.name: Bone Cleave
skills.description: The paired blade arms rake a wide sector. Get behind the crowned skull.

skills.name: Marrow Eruption
skills.description: A patch of bone spikes locks under you. Leave its outline before the eruption.

review.combat: Implemented using shared family controller; complete individual fight not replayed.
review.phase: Distinct form observed via explicitly labelled phase rehearsal; natural threshold crossing not reviewed.
